reviewer: Claude Code (the same session that wrote the converter); permitted by LGA-0001 (ai_review_in_session_permitted). NOT independent of the converter author and NOT a human review.
method: F7-style read of the generated Java (Portvald.java, LsValidationRequest.java, Cobol.java helpers) against the Step 14 conversion spec and test cases; no source text is quoted here.

checked.detail: I/A/T/M dispatch with case-sensitive single-character equality; lower-case types fall to WHEN OTHER (V16)
return code 1 (VAL-INVALID-ID) with the literal 'Invalid validation type', as written (V15)
4 characters moved into X(10) leave 6 spaces, so the NUMERIC test always fails; no ID can succeed (DR-PORTVALD-001; V01, V02)
the whole X(50) must be digits and not all zeros: exactly 50 digits (V03-V06, V17)
STK, BND, MMF, ETF compared space-padded to 50; leading space and lower case rejected (V07-V12)
non-digit content throws UnresolvedGapException(GAP-PORTVALD-0001); no return code is invented (V14 BLOCKED_AS_EXPECTED)
EXIT PARAGRAPH becomes return from the paragraph method; GOBACK returns from the call
numeric items to zero, alphanumeric to spaces, before any use; items without VALUE clauses are annotated
every defined path writes both LS-RETURN-CODE and LS-ERROR-MSG; earlier contents never leak (V17)
S9(13)V99 as BigDecimal scale 2; truncation, never rounding
only constants 0-4 are moved; no TRUNC-dependent value is produced

findings.title: V13 (all-digit amount) relies on an interpretation that no COBOL run has confirmed
findings.detail: The MOVE takes the low-order 13 integer digits of a 50-digit alphanumeric value. Standard COBOL treats all-digit alphanumeric senders as unsigned integers, but 50 digits exceeds the 18 or 31 digit numeric limits (ARITH option), so the result may depend on the compiler. The LS-VAL-AMT branch is already classified GAP, so its V13 PASS is not counted as verified behaviour.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with a captured legacy run, or widen GAP-PORTVALD-0001 to cover all amount content. A business or technical owner must decide; this review does not.

findings.title: the VAL-INVALID-AMT (return code 4) path is unreachable
findings.detail: after the MOVE the value is unsigned and at most 13 integer digits, so it always lies within the full-range bounds (DR-PORTVALD-003). Preserved as written; no fixture can reach it.
findings.recommendation: Business SME decision on the intended amount limits.

findings.title: the test harness rejects initial return codes of 10000 or more
findings.detail: the field-list parser accepts at most 4 digits, but a halfword COMP item may hold up to 32767 under TRUNC(BIN). This only restricts the harness; the program overwrites the return code on every path.

findings.title: naming differences from the Step 14 spec
findings.detail: the spec names the exception UnsupportedLegacyBehaviourException; the generator emits UnresolvedGapException. The gap ID is GAP-PORTVALD-0001 with stable_ref GAP-PORTVALD-4000-VALIDATE-AMOUNT-ALNUM-TO-NUMERIC-VAL-TEMP-NUM. The behaviour is the same.

findings.title: equivalence is not established
findings.detail: no COBOL compiler is available, so expected results come from the reviewed Step 14 cases, not from a legacy run (EQUIVALENCE_UNVERIFIED).
findings.recommendation: capture reference outputs on a COBOL toolchain before any claim of equivalence

verdict: No correctness defect against the source semantics on the paths exercised. PARTIAL is accurate. Not an acceptance.
